svg.title: Tetrium block diagram
svg.desc: Tetrium CPU hardware by RTL module, laid out as the pipeline F, D1, D2, A1, A2, M, E, W: caches, TLBs, branch predictors, microcode ROM, execution units, store buffer, paging unit and bus interface.
svg.text: Units are the RTL modules (rtl/tetrium_*.sv), laid out as the pipeline F → D1 → D2 → A1 → A2 → M → E → W; one micro-op per cycle. Default sizes (rtl/tetrium_cfg.svh).
Wishbone B4 bus · intr nmi a20m flush snoop
I/O › walk › stores › D fill › uncached › I fill
1 store per cycle · up to 8 outstanding
MOV ADD SUB INC DEC LEA SHL
redirect · BTB / predictor training (from E, A1, D1)
PDE / PTE · A / D bits · locked
BRAM: block RAM · LUT RAM: distributed RAM · DSP: multiplier blocks · WC: write-combining. Bus width 32 bits by default (64 in the MiSTer core).
